atomic_questions.shared_background: By a Final Decree dated 07.09.1999 entered in the Partition Case bearing No. 516/P of the District Court of Kaduwela, all that allotment land marked Lot 5 depicted in Partition Plan No. 1100 dated 06.05.1997 made by W.P. Gunaratne Licensed Surveyor of the land called Delgahawatta bearing Assessment No. 3A, Sarasavi Lane situated at Battaramulla 30 perches in extent was allotted to one Nihal Gamage. The said Nihal Gamage upon Deed of Gift No. 663 dated 21.11.2002 attested by Athula De Silva Notary Public of Colombo, gifted the said Lot 5 in the said Plan No.1100 unto his son, Piyal Gamage as an absolute and irrevocable gift subject to the life interests of the Donor and his wife Kanthi Gamage. Thereafter, Nihal Gamage died intestate on 28.04.2003 leaving as his intestate legal heirs his wife Kanthi Gamage, his 3 children by their marriage, namely, Piyal, Aruna, Leela and 2 children by his previous marriage to Anusha, namely Nikitha and Rikitha. Piyal Gamage died intestate on 02.08.2006 unmarried and issueless and his estate was administered and letters of Administration was issued to his mother Kanthi Gamage in the District Court of Kaduwela Case No.1052/2006/T. The proceedings were terminated on 27.11.2007. Kanthi Gamage met with an accident and died intestate on 17.03.2010. Rikitha married to Sanatha and died intestate on 02.08.2016 without having children.
